Shows a metric's direction of change in a table or card.

```jsx
<TrendIndicator direction="up">+3.1pp</TrendIndicator>
<TrendIndicator direction="down">−0.8pp</TrendIndicator>
<TrendIndicator direction="flat">flat</TrendIndicator>
```

Green is banned across the brand: up is blue, down is melon, flat is grey. Never override those colours.
